name: mcp-paradex
description: MCP server for Paradex — multi-asset exchange with spot, perpetuals, options, and commodity futures.
long_description: Connect AI assistants to Paradex, a privacy-preserving multi-asset exchange. Trade spot pairs, perpetual futures, dated options, and commodity/TradFi futures. Access real-time market data including orderbooks, trades, funding rates, and klines. Monitor account positions, balances, and transaction history. Place and manage orders with support for market, limit, stop, and take-profit order types. Track vault performance, positions, and transfers. Supports both read-only market data access and authenticated trading when configured with account credentials.

tools.name: paradex_system_config
tools.description: Get Paradex system configuration including exchange parameters, fee schedules, trading limits, and portfolio-margin params.

tools.name: paradex_system_state
tools.description: Get the current Paradex system operational status and server timestamp.

tools.name: paradex_filters_model
tools.description: Get JSON schema for data models used in JMESPath filtering (MarketDetails, MarketSummary, OrderState, Vault, VaultSummary).

tools.name: paradex_markets
tools.description: List available markets with details like tick size, min order size, and leverage limits. Supports JMESPath filtering and pagination.

tools.name: paradex_market_summaries
tools.description: Get market summaries with price, volume, and 24h change data. Supports JMESPath filtering and pagination.

tools.name: paradex_funding_data
tools.description: Get funding rate data for a specific market including funding rates, index prices, and premium.

tools.name: paradex_orderbook
tools.description: Get the orderbook (bids and asks) for a specific market at configurable depth.

tools.name: paradex_klines
tools.description: Get OHLCV candlestick data for a market at various resolutions (1m to 1h).

tools.name: paradex_trades
tools.description: Get recent trades for a specific market with fill data, size, price, and timestamps.

tools.name: paradex_bbo
tools.description: Get the best bid and offer (BBO) with spread data for a specific market.

tools.name: paradex_vaults
tools.description: List vaults with metadata, owner, operator, and strategy information. Supports JMESPath filtering.

tools.name: paradex_vault_overview
tools.description: Complete vault snapshot in one call: token balances, open positions, and trading account summary.

tools.name: paradex_vault_summary
tools.description: Get vault performance summaries including ROI, P&L, volume, and drawdown metrics.

tools.name: paradex_vault_transfers
tools.description: Get deposit and withdrawal transfer history for a specific vault.

tools.name: paradex_account_overview
tools.description: Complete live account snapshot in one call: margin health, token balances, open positions, fee tiers, and margin methodology. Requires authentication.

tools.name: paradex_account_summary
tools.description: Get account summary with value, free collateral, and margin requirements. Requires authentication.

tools.name: paradex_account_balance
tools.description: Get token balances for the account (USDC, DIME, etc.). Requires authentication.

tools.name: paradex_account_positions
tools.description: Get all open positions with P&L, liquidation price, and leverage. Requires authentication.

tools.name: paradex_account_fills
tools.description: Get trade fill history with price, size, fees, and realized PnL. Requires authentication.

tools.name: paradex_account_funding_payments
tools.description: Get funding payment history for account positions. Requires authentication.

tools.name: paradex_account_transactions
tools.description: Get account transaction history including deposits, withdrawals, and trades. Requires authentication.

tools.name: paradex_account_profile
tools.description: Get static account profile and settings: username, referral, max-slippage limits, TAP/XP rates, notifications. Requires authentication.

tools.name: paradex_account_keys
tools.description: List all credentials registered for this account: Paradex subkeys and JWT/API tokens, with their CIDR allowlists. Requires authentication.

tools.name: paradex_generate_subkey
tools.description: Generate a StarkNet keypair for use as a Paradex subkey. Persists the private key locally and returns only the public key.

tools.name: paradex_open_orders
tools.description: List currently open orders with status and fill details. Requires authentication.

tools.name: paradex_orders_history
tools.description: Get historical orders for a market within a time range. Requires authentication.

tools.name: paradex_order_status
tools.description: Check the status of a specific order by order ID or client ID. Requires authentication.

tools.name: paradex_create_order
tools.description: Place a new order (market, limit, stop, take-profit). Supports GTC, IOC, and POST_ONLY instructions. Requires authentication.

tools.name: paradex_cancel_orders
tools.description: Cancel orders by order ID, client ID, or all orders in a market. Requires authentication.

tools.name: paradex_trade_preview
tools.description: One-shot pre-trade analysis: readiness validation, SDK-backed margin impact (IM/MM before/after, free collateral), and fee/slippage/funding estimates. Requires authentication.

tools.name: paradex_block_trade_list
tools.description: List block trades (with optional status/market filters), or list offers attached to a specific block_trade_id.

tools.name: paradex_block_trade_get
tools.description: Fetch full details for a block trade including its trades, signers, and signatures.

tools.name: paradex_block_trade_create_offer_based
tools.description: Create a new offer-based block trade with single-leg constraints (initiator-side). Signs locally; no key material leaves the process.

tools.name: paradex_block_trade_submit_offer
tools.description: Submit an offer to an existing block trade as a counterparty. Signs locally.

tools.name: paradex_block_trade_execute
tools.description: Execute a block trade as the initiator with selected offers (offer-based) or direct (no offers).

tools.name: paradex_block_trade_cancel
tools.description: Cancel a block trade you initiated.

tools.name: paradex_block_trade_cancel_offer
tools.description: Cancel an offer you submitted against a block trade.

paradex_account_private_key.title: Account Private Key
paradex_account_private_key.description: Your Paradex account private key. Required for trading, account, and order tools. Leave empty if using an API Key instead.

paradex_account_address.title: Account Address
paradex_account_address.description: Your Paradex account address. Optional — derived from private key or extracted from API Key automatically.

paradex_api_key.title: API Key
paradex_api_key.description: Your Paradex API key (long-term JWT token). Alternative to Account Private Key — account address is extracted automatically.
